lessons.title: Origins — Chi-Town Soul, Backpacker Rap, & The Roc

body.text: & The Roc Goals: Show the soil Kanye came from. “How does struggle turn into creativity?”

body.label: Key points
items: Chicago — duality of Black middle-class + city grit
Beats for local acts → eventually for Jay-Z
Why Roc-A-Fella didn’t want to sign him as a rapper
Accident → jaw wired shut → “Through the Wire” (pure willpower)

body.text: Everyman Goals: Teach personality-driven rap. Break down “All Falls Down” for economic commentary. Your son gon’ learn sociology through music.

items: Commentary on student debt, religion, family, systemic issues
Why Kanye felt relatable to a whole generation
